analysis.association_source: 051 summary.json crest_db Q5-Q1: PQ +0.4396 over a 6.929 dB crest gap; OLS slope over the same clips is +0.0525 per dB

decision_rule.slope_ci_excludes_zero_and_at_least_half: crest is a causal lever on PQ; training toward crest would hack AES, and any PQ comparison whose arms differ in crest must be re-read
decision_rule.slope_ci_excludes_zero_but_far_below_ass: partial; the association is mostly confounded
decision_rule.slope_ci_includes_zero: the association is not reproduced by intervention; crest is a proxy - do not train toward it, find the underlying factor

analysis.exclusion_rule: A clip is dropped from the analysis, in all arms together, if (a) its baseline integrated loudness is below min_baseline_lufs or its silence fraction exceeds max_silence_fraction (pre-treatment screen), or (b) any arm could not be held at the target loudness or breached the peak ceiling. Near-silent clips cannot be held at a fixed gated loudness because expansion pushes their quiet majority under the gate. Both counts are reported; exclusion is at clip level so the paired design is intact.
analysis.prespecified_limits: Attenuation-and-expansion only at one checkpoint and one generation seed; a CI covering zero is insufficient evidence, not equivalence; AES is not a human quality judgment.
analysis.primary_endpoint: pooled paired dose-response slope dPQ per dB achieved crest delta, all intervention arms vs ref, n=5521 clips x 4 arms
analysis.secondary: per-arm paired AES deltas and per-arm dose-response slopes for CE/CU/PC; up vs rand at matched achieved crest delta; robustness slope restricted to clips under low_modulation_db
analysis.why_not_nominal_target: A nominal +3 dB contrast was dropped after the pilot: the reachable crest change is clip-dependent, and forcing the target drove gain modulation to 18-21 dB RMS and centroid to 0.82 on clips that still did not move, which would have measured processing severity instead of crest.

launch_authorization.scope: Operator asked for the fixed-LUFS crest post-processing intervention and chose queue tail placement as 061.

protocol.generation: none; reuses the 051 hash-verified baseline FLAC

question: Does the 051 descriptive crest<->PQ association survive a within-clip intervention that moves crest while holding integrated loudness fixed?

resume.behavior: Every transform and AES record is an atomic contract-bound per-clip JSON verified against the source hash; a restart re-does only missing clips.

down.role: largest crest reduction reachable under the cap; selected by achieved minimum because the ratio-to-crest map is non-monotone

rand.role: the up gain envelope circularly shifted: modulation depth matched, decorrelated from musical structure. Not a null-crest placebo - random slow modulation raises crest by itself, which is the point: it separates crest-as-a-number from structure-following expansion.

ref.role: pure scalar gain to base LUFS + pad; paired reference for every contrast

up.role: structure-following expansion aiming at +3 dB crest; achieved delta is the dose, the target is not a claim

upmax.role: largest crest increase reachable under the modulation cap; supplies dose spread

transform.audio_hashing: Manifest hashes cover the decoded float32 samples plus the sample rate, not the file bytes: libsndfile stamps a PEAK chunk carrying a Unix timestamp into float WAV headers, so identical audio hashes differently on every write. Content hashing makes a delete-and-rebuild verifiable against the previous manifest.
transform.description: Smooth time-varying gain only: an attack/release envelope follower feeding a one-pole-smoothed dB curve. No per-sample nonlinearity, so no harmonic distortion. Ratios are grid-searched under a gain-modulation cap because crest is not monotone in the ratio and heavy processing pushes crest back up in both directions; the cap keeps every arm a mild transform so the contrast is about crest, not severity.
transform.lufs_normalisation: Iterated: gated loudness is not exactly scalar-equivariant, so the normaliser re-measures until the residual is within 0.01 LU.
transform.pad_policy: pad_db is the nominal attenuation applied to every arm of a clip. Clips whose loudest arm would breach peak_ceiling_dbfs get extra attenuation applied to ALL their arms, recorded as pad_db_effective. The pad is constant within a clip, so it cancels in the paired contrasts.
transform.reachability: Achieved crest change is clip-dependent and bounded: clips whose baseline crest is already high cannot be expanded further under the cap. This is a property of the signal, recorded per clip, not a failure to be tuned away.
